title: Exactly-once is the wrong mental model for most agent side effects.
hook: Exactly-once is the wrong mental model for most agent side effects.
thesis: The technical position: for agent side effects against external systems, exactly-once is usually unachievable and the wrong goal; the right model is durable intent plus idempotent reconciliation. UNKNOWN is a real state, and uncertain effects reconcile through a concrete read instead of being blindly retried or blindly repeated. The hook is earned by showing the reconciliation read, the UNKNOWN state semantics, and failure-injection evidence that recovery does not duplicate the mutation.

proven: The directive states the reconciliation requirement and the UNKNOWN state vocabulary (sections 6, 7).
partial: Reconciliation reads are implemented for the adapters the content will name.
unknown: Measured failure-injection runs showing no duplicate mutation after restart.

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
